svg.title: Dai Kenja — Doctrine of Overflow. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance (roster pass) / Dai Kenja classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 8 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Brimming Cup forks into Flooded Meridians then Boundless Reservoir. Sage's Rebuke forks into Smothered Current then Edict of Silence, or Cracked Vessel then Shattered Vessel. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Dai Kenja-classified jutsu (requires classification extension).

DEBUFF","adverse":false,"base":30.0,"gain":2,"final":32.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["Shattered Vessel"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than Draft 5's ten and four. Damage reaches one row (Overloaded Impact, 40 EP, cooldown 6) and the only thing that can set up that strike is Chakra Overload's exposure, cast a round earlier: Overloaded Impact's own self buff is inert in its cast round and expires before its next cast. So Draft 5's Burst (Chakra Surcharge \u2192 Breaking Point) and Exposure routes are one lever and form one exposure \u2192 strike route (Cracked Vessel \u2192 Shattered Vessel); Chakra Surcharge and Breaking Point are removed. No distinct fourth Advanced Art exists: a separate strike route would need either an Increase Damage Taken setup (a twin of Cracked Vessel) or an Increase Damage Given one, which never reaches the strike, only repeats Amplification at a smaller size, and under Brimming Cup would push the kit's one Increase Damage Given row past +10% as Boundless Reservoir's fourth purchase; a separate exposure route is net-negative one-on-one (caster \u00d71.04 against target \u00d71.037) and twins Cracked Vessel; an amplify-and-suppress capstone only blends the two existing routes on the same rows. Sage's Rebuke is a universal node (in all 8 legal 4-BP builds) because Brimming Cup roots a single 3-node chain; the only way to break that is a Hidden-Art leaf under Brimming Cup, which would be filler, so Boundless Reservoir's fourth purchase is fixed.","design_notes":["Structure (rewired to 2/3/3): Brimming Cup roots one amplification chain (Flooded Meridians \u2192 Boundless Reservoir); Sage's Rebuke forks into suppression (Smothered Current \u2192 Edict of Silence) and exposure \u2192 strike (Cracked Vessel \u2192 Shattered Vessel). Brimming Cup: \"How do I make the window after Overloaded Impact hit harder?\" Sage's Rebuke: \"How do I break the enemy: blunt their blows, or crack them open for my strike?\"","Routes: Amplification +10% Increase Damage Given (2 + 3 + 5); Suppression +10% Decrease Damage Given (2 + 3 + 5); exposure \u2192 strike +5% Increase Damage Taken (Cracked Vessel +3, Shattered Vessel +2) and +2 Damage (Shattered Vessel). Maxima over every legal allocation: Damage +2, Increase Damage Given +10%, Decrease Damage Given +10%, Increase Damage Taken +5%; not jointly attainable.","Magnitudes against the roster conventions: Boundless Reservoir's +10% sits on one row, the limit for a one-row route; it carries no rider because every other tag in the kit is another route's primary (Decrease Damage Given is Suppression's, Increase Damage Taken and Damage are Shattered Vessel's), and at +10% it is about even with Shattered Vessel (like-for-like note below). Edict of Silence's +10% covers two rows that compound on one target, above the +8% two-row convention. It is kept because Blood-Enchanted Eyes' director-reviewed Red Pestilence puts the same +10% on the same row shape (a 40 AP single-target and a 60 AP area Decrease Damage Given row) with a Decrease Damage Taken rider on top; the two rows ride separate casts (cooldowns 6 and 7) and compound only when both land within one window. Relative to baseline the full route cuts a doubly debuffed target's hits by \u00d70.39/0.525 \u2248 \u00d70.743.","Changes from Draft 5 (the pre-batch tree): Draft 5 had four Advanced Arts. Its Burst route put flat Damage on the Hidden Art (Chakra Surcharge +2 \u2192 Breaking Point +3 Damage and +2% Increase Damage Given; Overloaded Impact 40 \u2192 45, a whole-tier jump) and its Exposure route was Cracked Vessel +2% \u2192 Shattered Vessel +3% Increase Damage Taken with a +3% Decrease Damage Given rider. The batch caps the strike at +2 on the Advanced Art behind an exposure setup (the RUL-2026-10-04-001/002 pattern): Cracked Vessel becomes +3% Increase Damage Taken and Shattered Vessel +2 Damage with +2% Increase Damage Taken (exposure still +5%, self row 30%, strike 40 \u2192 42). Shattered Vessel drops the Decrease Damage Given rider, which Suppression owns. Amplification and Suppression keep Draft 5's values.","Timing (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73b): buffs and debuffs are inert in their cast round (tags.ts 925, 1010; util.ts 2567\u20132577) and live in the two rounds after it. Shattered Vessel's strike lands into Chakra Overload's exposure only when Chakra Overload was cast in an earlier round; both have cooldown 6, so the order can hold every cycle. Overloaded Impact's self buff and self exposure then run for the two rounds after the strike; the buff multiplies every Ninjutsu or non-elemental hit in that window (getEfficiencyRatio, tags.ts 3477\u20133510; computeDamagePacket, process.ts 1692\u20131825), and the 15% bloodline passive applies last.","Like-for-like (both builds hold Brimming Cup and Sage's Rebuke), Shattered Vessel against Boundless Reservoir: the strike \u00d71.05 \u00d7 1.40/1.35 \u2248 \u00d71.089; a caster hit in the round after the strike (exposure and buff both live) \u00d71.32/1.35 \u2248 \u00d70.978, one in the next round \u00d71.32/1.40 \u2248 \u00d70.943; an ally's Ninjutsu or non-elemental hit on the target in Chakra Overload's window \u00d71.037; hits the caster takes in the two rounds after the strike \u00d71.30/1.25 = \u00d71.04. With strike-sized hits, one window hit per round is about even (+0.12 against \u22120.04 \u2212 0.08 strike-units); Boundless Reservoir leads from the third window hit, and allies on the target favour Shattered Vessel. Damage taken as proportional to EP; not simulated.","Delivery and uptime: Overloaded Impact is 60 AP, cooldown 6, one single-target hit at range 4. Chakra Overload is 40 AP single target, cooldown 6; Chakra Cannon a 60 AP AOE circle, cooldown 7. Both suppression debuffs sit on one target only when the casts land in the same or consecutive rounds (100 AP in all), so \u00d70.39 is a ceiling.","Fourth purchases: Amplification's is fixed (Sage's Rebuke, +2% Decrease Damage Given). Suppression takes Brimming Cup (+2% Increase Damage Given, no self cost) or Cracked Vessel (+3% exposure, self row 28%). Exposure \u2192 strike takes Brimming Cup (self buff 32%) or Smothered Current (Decrease Damage Given 30% / 35%). No sibling Hidden Art carries its capstone's primary tag, so no fourth purchase pushes a route past its own total or rebuilds a sibling route: Suppression with Cracked Vessel has no Damage, and Shattered Vessel with Smothered Current stops at +5% Decrease Damage Given."],"risks":["Adverse row proposed under OPEN_DECISIONS D11 (open; ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G14), held at the drafted +5%: Increase Damage Taken nodes also raise Overloaded Impact's self exposure (all damage; 28% with Cracked Vessel, 30% with Shattered Vessel) for the two rounds after each cast, atop the 5% passive. One-on-one the self row's cost (\u00d71.30/1.25 = \u00d71.04) slightly exceeds the enemy row's gain (\u00d71.40/1.35 \u2248 \u00d71.037), so the exposure half is net-negative alone; the route pays through Shattered Vessel's +2 Damage strike, and its exposure only when allies focus the target.","Ally hazard (Chakra Cannon#1): Cannon is an OTHER_USER AOE circle with friendly fire ALL, so an ally in the circle (never the caster) receives its two-round suppression at the enhanced 32\u201340% (actions.ts 1029\u20131060); every Decrease Damage Given node raises it, and positioning decides. Chakra Overload's suppression is ENEMIES-only; its ALL exposure row lands on an ally only if aimed at one.","Single-cast concentration: the Brimming Cup chain and Shattered Vessel's Damage modify Overloaded Impact only (one 60 AP single-target cast, cooldown 6). Amplification pays only on Ninjutsu or non-elemental hits in the two rounds after that cast, Shattered Vessel's +2 on one hit per cycle, so their order depends on the rest of the caster's loadout and on allies.","Suppression stacking: Chakra Overload and Chakra Cannon apply separate two-round Decrease Damage Given debuffs; with BATTLE_TAG_STACKING on, every same-tag effect applies and the reductions compound in sequence (process.ts 1109\u20131117, 1692\u20131825), so one target's non-pierce hits are cut to \u00d70.75 \u00d7 0.70 = \u00d70.525 at baseline and \u00d70.65 \u00d7 0.60 = \u00d70.39 at the route maximum (floor \u00d70.10), lower still with an allied Dai Kenja. Not simulated.","Downstream reach: the self buff multiplies every Ninjutsu or non-elemental hit the caster lands in its window (normal jutsu, basic attacks, weapons); enemy-side suppression and exposure alter damage from allies and weapons too. Stat filters on element-less rows are not binding (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73, getEfficiencyRatio).","Classification: no kit row carries an element, so the tree requires a classification extension. 'Dai Kenja' is the placeholder name of a new jutsu classification assigned to jutsu records, not a bloodline-id selector; which jutsu carry it is a director/engine decision. All three kit jutsu qualify only through it (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Off-kit coverage is unverified.","Unsupported rows: Chakra Cannon's pierce (58 at level 25) and Chakra Overload's increasepoolcost (100%) receive no bonus; pierce is processed after the damage-modifier pass, so the self buff and the exposure do not raise the pierce hit and Suppression does not reduce enemy pierce.","Rank context: Dai Kenja is a D-rank bloodline with B/C/A-rank jutsu; the tree weighs marginal opportunity, not final strength. Skill-tree effects are skipped in ranked PvP and ranked sparring. not director-approved","foundation_sentences":{"01":"How do I make the window after Overloaded Impact hit harder?","06":"How do I break the enemy: blunt their blows, or crack them open for my strike?"},"route_identities":{"05":"sustained amplification: the caster's own hits in the two rounds after the strike (pure Increase Damage Given, not burst)","08":"suppression: both control casts, compounding on one target","10":"burst: Chakra Overload's exposure set up on the Hidden Art, a controlled +2 Damage strike landed into it"},"director_review":"Structural: Draft 5's ten nodes and four Advanced Arts become eight and three (narrow-kit exception); its Burst (Chakra Surcharge \u2192 Breaking Point, 40 \u2192 45) and Exposure routes merge into one exposure \u2192 strike route (Cracked Vessel +3% Increase Damage Taken \u2192 Shattered Vessel +2 Damage, +2% Increase Damage Taken; 40 \u2192 42), which leaves Sage's Rebuke universal. Magnitude: Edict of Silence keeps +10% Decrease Damage Given on two rows that compound on one target (Red Pestilence precedent; the roster convention is +8%). The adverse Overloaded Impact self row (25 \u2192 30%) is proposed under OPEN_DECISIONS D11, still open, at its drafted +5% size.","concerns":["Shattered Vessel against Boundless Reservoir one-on-one (like-for-like 4-BP builds): damage dealt is about even with one strike-sized window hit per round and Boundless Reservoir leads from the third window hit, while Shattered Vessel's caster takes \u00d71.04 in the two rounds after the strike; allies hitting the marked target favour Shattered Vessel. Arithmetic only, not simulated.","The exposure half of Shattered Vessel is slightly net-negative one-on-one (target \u00d71.037, caster \u00d71.04); its solo value is the +2 Damage strike.","Sage's Rebuke is in every legal 4-BP build, so Boundless Reservoir's fourth purchase is fixed at +2% Decrease Damage Given; the only alternative is a filler Hidden-Art leaf under Brimming Cup.","Boundless Reservoir is a bare single-row +10% Increase Damage Given route; the director anchors give their +10% amplification routes a rider (Dragon in Full Blossom) or stop at +8% (Arashima). This kit has no rider tag that is not another route's primary, and the self buff multiplies every Ninjutsu or non-elemental hit in its two-round window.","Edict of Silence is single-tag where Blood-Enchanted Eyes' Red Pestilence carries a Decrease Damage Taken rider; the kit has no Decrease Damage Taken, Heal or Lifesteal row, so the defensive capstone reads lighter than the anchor."]}}

g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
DAI KENJA CLASSIFICATION · REQUIRES CLASSIFICATION EXTENSION
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Dai Kenja-classified jutsu (requires classification extension). Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Edict of Silence path + Brimming Cup
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE DAI KENJA KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
8 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance (roster pass) / Dai Kenja classification / forked tree
